top.name: Full Metal Jacket
top.description: Shots pop through 4 layers of Bloon, and both bullets and shrapnel can pop Lead and Frozen Bloons. Wiki: The Sniper's shots deal Normal-type damage, letting it pop Lead and Frozen Bloons, and increases damage of its bullet from 2 to 4. With Shrapnel Shot, the shrapnel each deals 2 damage and also pops Lead and Frozen.

top.name: Large Caliber
top.description: Shots can pop through 7 layers of Bloon. Wiki: This upgrade increases the damage of its bullet attack from 4 to 7. With the Shrapnel Shot crosspath, the shrapnels gain +1 damage for a total of 3. With Bouncing Bullet and its subsequent upgrades, the bounce distance is increased from 40 to 80.

top.name: Deadly Precision
top.description: 20 damage per shot, plus bonus damage to ceramics. Wiki: This upgrade increases the Sniper Monkey's damage from 7 to 20, and grants +50 Ceramic damage. With the Shrapnel Shot Crosspath, this upgrade increases shrapnel damage from 3 to 4.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +50 damage vs Ceramic; cannot hit Camo; hits only target (instant)

top.name: Maim MOAB
top.description: Deals much more damage and projectiles immobilize MOAB-Class Bloons for a short time. Wiki: This upgrade increases the damage of Sniper Monkey's bullets from 20 to 30, and applies a stun to MOAB-Class Bloons except BADs and Boss Bloons, preventing them from moving for a short time. With the Shrapnel Shot crosspath, shrapnel can also stun MOAB-Class Bloons for 66% the normal duration, and shrapnel damage increases from 4 to 6.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +50 damage vs Ceramic; cannot hit Camo; hits only target (instant); Maim MOAB(multiplier=0, lifespanForMoab=3, lifespanForBfb=1.5, lifespanForZomg=0.75, lifespanForDdt=0.75, lifespanForBad=0, addDamagePerHit=0)

top.name: Cripple MOAB
top.description: Crippled MOABs are immobilized for longer and take extra damage from all other attacks. Wiki: This upgrade increases the stun duration on MOAB-Class Bloons, as well as causing them to receive a cripple debuff. While crippled, targets take +5 damage from all sources. The damage of Sniper Monkey's bullets increases from 30 to 140, and grants bullets an Explosion-type area of effect that deals 28 damage to up to 10 Bloons near the impact location (up to a distance of 8 units). This effect does not stun or cripple blimps. With the Shrapnel Shot crosspath, shrapnel can now stun and debuff MOAB-Class Bloons for roughly 66% of the normal duration. Additionally, shrapnel damage is increased from 6 to 12 and pierce increased from 2 to 6, plus extra projectile speed and lifespan.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +50 damage vs Ceramic; cannot hit Camo; hits only target (instant); Maim MOAB(multiplier=0, lifespanForMoab=7, lifespanForBfb=6, lifespanForZomg=3, lifespanForDdt=4, lifespanForBad=0.75, addDamagePerHit=5)

middle.name: Night Vision Goggles
middle.description: Allows Sniper to detect and do an additional 2 damage to Camo Bloons. Wiki: This upgrade allows the Sniper Monkey's attacks to target Camo Bloons and increases its bonus Camo damage by +2.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +2 damage vs Camo; hits only target (instant)

middle.name: Shrapnel Shot
middle.description: Damaged Bloons spray out a cone of sharp shrapnel. Wiki: With this upgrade, each shot from the Sniper Monkey emits 5 shrapnel projectiles from behind the target in a 45° angle spread. Each shrapnel projectile deals 1 damage, +2 damage to Camo Bloons (inherited from Night Vision Goggles), and can pop up to 2 Bloons. Shrapnel does not deal damage to the target initially hit by the bullet.

new_attack.name: Attack/Shrapnel
new_attack.notes: +2 damage vs Camo; speed 160; collision radius 0.2; spread angle 45

middle.name: Bouncing Bullet
middle.description: Shots bounce to new targets up to 2 times. Wiki: This upgrade allows the Sniper Monkey's bullets to bounce up to 2 times, hitting up to 3 Bloons per shot. Each bullet impact retains the Shrapnel Shot attack, triggering 5 shrapnel in a cone formation parallel to the direction of the bullet, with 2 pierce per shrapnel. Bullets can bounce to other Bloons within a 40 unit radius of a target, always bounces towards the closest targets, and the bounces can ignore obstacles. Crosspathing with Full Metal Jacket increases shrapnel damage to 2 and grants Normal-type damage to its shrapnel. With Large Calibre, the bounce distance increases from 40 to 80 units and shrapnel damage increases to 3.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +2 damage vs Camo; hits only target (instant); max pierce 3; bounces 9999999 times (range 40); lifespan 2s

middle.name: Supply Drop
middle.description: Supply Drop Ability: toggles either a crate full of cash, or a special ammo crate that grants improved shrapnel that can pop all Bloon types for the next few shots. Wiki: This upgrade grants the Sniper Monkey an Activated Ability that spawns a collectable crate after a short delay. The ability can be toggled to drop cash worth $1100 or grant a buff to itself, gaining +3 pierce, 2× damage, 2× projectile lifespan, and Normal damage type for all its attacks for up to 6 shots. Additionally, the maximum bounces per bullet increases from 2 to 4 (hitting up to 5 Bloons), and the pierce of each shrapnel increases from 2 to 5.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +2 damage vs Camo; hits only target (instant); max pierce 5; bounces 9999999 times (range 40); lifespan 2s

middle.name: Elite Sniper
middle.description: Cash Supply Drop gives much more cash. Ammo Supply Drop buffs up to 2 other nearby Snipers. Grants Elite targeting prio and faster reload to all snipers. Wiki: This upgrade increases Sniper Monkey's attack speed (x0.4 attack cooldown or +150% more attack speed). Elite Sniper also grants a global attack speed buff to all other Sniper Monkeys (x0.75 attack cooldown, equal to about +33% attack speed). Additionally, all Sniper Monkeys including itself gain a new "Elite" targeting option, which the Elite Sniper automatically switches to after upgrading. Elite Sniper's cash crate ability generates $3000 instead of $1100, and the ammo crate also buffs up to 2 of the closest non-Paragon Snipers with Shrapnel Shot or above. Upon upgrading, this ability's cooldown is reset to 90 seconds.

bottom.name: Fast Firing
bottom.description: Shoots faster than normal. Wiki: This upgrade reduces Sniper Monkey's attack cooldown by 30%, for a ~42.9% attack speed increase. Without additional upgrades, its attack cooldown is 1.113 seconds.

bottom.name: Even Faster Firing
bottom.description: Shoots even faster! Wiki: This upgrade reduces Sniper Monkey's attack cooldown by 30%, for a ~42.9% attack speed increase compared to the previous tier or a ~2.04x attack speed increase compared to base. Without additional upgrades, its attack cooldown is 0.7791 seconds.

bottom.name: Semi-Automatic
bottom.description: Attacks 3x as fast! Wiki: This upgrade reduces the Sniper Monkey's attack cooldown by ~66.67%, effectively tripling its attack speed. With this upgrade, Sniper Monkey shoots ~6.12× faster than if it had no upgrades. It has an attack cooldown of 0.2597 seconds.

bottom.name: Full Auto Rifle
bottom.description: Fully automatic weapon with incredible popping power. Wiki: This upgrade reduces Sniper Monkey's attack cooldown by 50%, making it twice as fast as Semi-Automatic and ~12.25× faster than a base Sniper Monkey. It has an attack cooldown of 0.1298 seconds. Additionally, this upgrade grants +2 MOAB-Class damage to its bullets. With Shrapnel Shot, Shrapnel gains +1 bonus damage to Ceramic Bloons.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +2 damage vs Moabs; cannot hit Camo; hits only target (instant)

bottom.name: Elite Defender
bottom.description: Fires super fast and does more damage to MOAB-class Bloons. Fires faster the further the Bloons are along the track. Gains 4x attack speed briefly on losing lives. Wiki: This upgrade reduces Sniper Monkey's attack cooldown by 50%, effectively doubling its attack speed, and increases the bullets' MOAB-Class damage from +2 to +4. Additionally, it gains more attack speed equal to the percentage of the track that the furthest Bloon is at, up to +100%, in increments of 1%. Its base attack cooldown is reduced to 0.0649 seconds. Elite Defender also has a passive ability that grants 4× faster attack speed for 7 seconds upon losing lives. This ability has a 10-second cooldown (5-second cooldown with Master Defender). At its maximum attack speed, Elite Defender attacks 16× faster than Full Auto Rifle.

changes.Attack/Projectile.notes: +4 damage vs Moabs; cannot hit Camo; hits only target (instant)
